name: Yakabe Hikaru
source:
At Kimisaki Academy, no one tops Hikaru's judo skills. [url=/c98278]Renren[/url] often ambushes her even when there's no practice. Hikaru recognizes the talent in [url=/c98253]Isami[/url] and works to train her in spite of Isami's unwillingness. She is also [url=/c98551]Ayame[/url]'s childhood friend.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
